title: Job-category tags now save permanently
description: Tagging a company or signal to a job category in Services used to only last for the current tab session. Tags now save to the backend as soon as you tap them, load back in every time you open the app, and get folded into the permanent company directory overnight.

title: This "What's new" panel
description: A running log of fixes and features, right from the top bar — no more guessing what changed between visits.

title: Saved companies fill in their own website, city and country
description: When a Research Desk search doesn't return a company's website or location, the app now automatically runs a second, targeted lookup before saving — so saved companies land in the right country's list without needing any manual backend update.

title: Fixed: company Website links went nowhere
description: Every company's "Website" link on its detail page was pointing at a placeholder instead of the real address. It now opens the actual site in a new tab, or shows "Not on file" when no website is known.

title: Fixed: Watched websites list appearing empty
description: Adding a site to "Also watch this website" worked, but the list kept showing empty afterward. The root cause was the app caching an old, empty response from before the feature was fully set up. That stale cache is now bypassed for all live backend data, so the list reflects what's actually saved.

title: Save to directory
description: Research Desk and Discover-a-company results can now be saved straight into the company directory, with an optional "also watch this website" toggle so future news about it gets picked up automatically.

title: Security fix: AI-sourced text is now escaped everywhere
description: Contact emails, sources and other text pulled in from research results are now properly escaped before display, closing a gap where malformed or malicious HTML in a result could render incorrectly.

title: Fixed: Services tile grid off-center on narrow screens
description: The 12 job-category tiles could overflow or sit left-aligned on narrower phone widths. They now stay centered at every screen size.
